'''Simol Toc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]], in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. Toc spent most of his life working on the planet [[Endregaad]] and after an outbreak of a [[Endregaad Plague|deadly viral disease]] on the world<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> Toc organized a caravan of cargo lifters towed by [[chando]]s&mdash;large, [[Dinosaur/Legends|dinosaur]]-like creatures&mdash;to deliver medicinal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to families living in the [[Temple Valley]] region.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
